description: Rearrange shape items in a group: delete, duplicate, move to a position, Group Shapes (wrap the items in a new group), Ungroup Shapes (dissolve groups) or Convert To Bezier Path (turn a rectangle, ellipse or polystar into a free path). Grouping, ungrouping and converting open the composition and run the Layer > Mask and Shape Path command on the items

action.description: What to do with the items

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

group.description: The group to work in: names or 1-based indexes of nested groups from the layer's Contents, e.g. ["Shape 1"]. Omit for Contents itself

items.description: Items in the group, by name or 1-based index

layers.description: Which shape layers: indexes (1-based), names, or selected: true

toIndex.description: move: the new 1-based position in the group

name: arrange_shape_content
title: Arrange Shape Content
